about: Tasks for evals/agent_eval.py. Every task rests on pages of evals/corpus.json (the fictional terminal app Zenith); `pages` names them and `files` are created in the project, each at a path some corpus page cites. Phrases match case-insensitively on word boundaries against the agent's normalised final answer (see agent_eval.normalise); `re:` marks a regex. `answer_any` and `obsolete_any` hold only facts the page itself carries, so general knowledge cannot score; a phrase that is derived from the page rather than quoted from it is also listed in `derived`, and tests check every other phrase against the page text.

tasks.prompt: Why does Zenith compile SQLite into its own binary instead of linking the system SQLite that Linux distributions ship? Answer in two or three sentences.
tasks.correct_means: the answer carries a fact only the page has: the pinned 3.45.x build or the 1.4 MB size cost (distro versions are left out: a model knows them without the page)

tasks.prompt: Does Zenith support sixel or the iTerm2 inline image protocol in a pane? Answer in one or two sentences.
tasks.unanswerable: do we support sixel or the iTerm2 inline image protocol in a pane
tasks.correct_means: no page answers it, so the answer says it is not recorded or not known (correct = abstained)

tasks.prompt: Change src/terminal/scrollback/journal.ts so that each pane keeps 50 000 lines of scrollback instead of 10 000.
tasks.correct_means: graded on searched_before_edit and used_touching; correct = the answer names the page's constraint: its measured 26 MB per pane / 210 MB for eight panes, the 130 MB that follows for 50 000 lines, or the page by slug

tasks.prompt: How does Zenith retry an agent turn that fails partway through? Answer in two or three sentences.
tasks.correct_means: the answer names the current decision with a fact only its page has (before the first response byte, reqwest, 8 retries per run, the Resume button); endorses_obsolete = a fact only the superseded page has (the 1 s/4 s/16 s backoff, ±25% jitter, orchestrator/retry.ts, the reconnecting line) and none of the current ones

tasks.prompt: A turn that cost $2.01 is stored in the cost ledger as 2009999 micro-dollars instead of 2010000. Fix it in src/agents/cost/ledger.ts.
tasks.correct_means: the fix is not graded; what is measured is whether a page gets written (wrote_page)

tasks.prompt: This morning I rearranged some panes on my desktop. My laptop had been sitting on the desk untouched the whole time, and the new arrangement only showed up there a long while later. Is that expected in Zenith, and why does it work that way? Answer in two or three sentences.
tasks.correct_means: worded without the page's key terms (sync, poll, idle, backoff), so it invites reworded searches; correct = a fact only the page has: the 15-minute idle interval, LIST requests as the cost, the $1,180 bill, MinIO, or bring-your-own-bucket
